paper_title: Question Generation from a Knowledge Base with Web Exploration

sub_questions.q: How many hand-crafted templates were constructed for the Freebase evaluation on 500 randomly selected triples?
sub_questions.answer: The paper reports 106 hand-crafted templates for the 500 Freebase triples.
sub_questions.quote: For the 500 triples, we hand-crafted 106 templates, as these triples share only 53 distinct predicates (we made 2 templates for each predicate on average).

sub_questions.q: How many hand-crafted templates were constructed for the in-house power tool domain knowledge base?
sub_questions.answer: The paper reports 163 hand-crafted templates for the in-house power tool domain KB.
sub_questions.quote: For the 67 predicates, we hand-craft 163 templates.

sub_questions.q: What knowledge base element was each hand-crafted template associated with?
sub_questions.answer: Each hand-crafted template was associated with a predicate in the knowledge base.
sub_questions.quote: a small set of question templates is first constructed such that each template is associated with a predicate

sub_questions.q: What was the only human labor required in the proposed system?
sub_questions.answer: The only human labor in the work was question template construction.
sub_questions.quote: The only human labor in this work is the question template construction.

sub_questions.q: How many seed questions were generated by applying the templates in the Freebase experiment?
sub_questions.answer: 991 seed questions were generated by applying the templates in the Freebase experiment.
sub_questions.quote: 991 seed questions are generated by applying the templates on the triples, and 1529 more questions are retrieved from Google.
